Decision Check: CallPool with a ceiling on calls in flight and a hedge (a call unanswered after hedge_after_seconds is sent once more, first answer wins)

Decision Check (reply): overlapping stages on one bounded pool (confirm a view's spans as soon as it answers, repair a span as soon as it is confirmed), a view's spans confirmed in one call each, two confirmations first and the third only on a split; same rule: every flag checked, no confirmed failure ships unchanged
Quick acknowledgement: a status marked kind ack, sent by code before any slow work, within one second of the turn's start; Acknowledger and Emitter.ack send it once
Decision Check: confirm every flagged span by majority; a confirmed failure is rewritten or removed, never shipped unchanged
